login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to continue.
login.description: Your credentials are handled by Cynara Identity. After sign-in, choose a hospital you belong to.
login.credentialsManaged: You will enter your credentials on the secure identity page.
login.callbackFailed: Sign-in could not be completed. Start again.
login.identityDenied: Sign-in was cancelled or denied by the identity provider.
login.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect. Try again.

logout.title: Sign out
logout.signedOutDescription: The refresh token was revoked and the session cookie cleared.
logout.failed: Could not complete sign-out. The local session was cleared anyway.

hospital.title: Choose a hospital
hospital.description: Select a hospital workspace from your active memberships.
hospital.none: No hospital memberships are available for this account.
hospital.error: That hospital could not be selected. Try again.

recovery.title: Reset your password
recovery.description: Enter your account. If it exists, we will send reset instructions.
recovery.success: If the account exists, a password reset message has been sent.
recovery.error: The request could not be completed. Try again.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.description: Use the reset code from your message to choose a new password.
reset.success: Password updated. You can sign in now.
reset.error: The reset request could not be completed. Check the details and try again.
